Named tribal government

Seminole Tribe of Florida

The Seminole Tribe of Florida is a tribal government with headquarters in Hollywood, Florida. The tribe’s public introduction describes a Tribal Council and a Board of Directors, with elected representation tied to reservation communities.

Identification references

These references support the name and the limited relationships or locations described above. They do not count as substantive history reviews. Detailed reading sources remain queued.

  1. Introduction — Seminole Tribe of Florida ↗

    The Tribe-published introduction identifies its publisher as Seminole Tribe of Florida. Its separately inspected public Culture FAQ explicitly distinguishes that political entity from wider Seminole peoples and names Florida and Oklahoma governments separately. No claim is made that the Florida government represents all Seminole people.

    Seminole Tribe of Florida · Check recorded October 28, 2026 · Identification only

    Bureau of Indian Affairs / Federal Register · Check recorded October 28, 2026 · Identification only
